summary.title: Handoff summary
summary.subtitle: Check every line before the summary goes with a referral.
summary.startBody: AI can draft a summary from the facts in this case. You check every line, then approve or reject it. Nothing is used until you approve it.
summary.aiNote: AI used only the facts in this case. It cannot send anything, change urgency or edit the record.
summary.checkNone: The draft reported nothing missing or conflicting.
summary.keptWho: Your name, the time, and whether you approved or rejected it
summary.keptText: The text you approve, with every change you make
summary.keptModel: The AI version that drafted it: {model}, prompt {prompt}
summary.keptNote: Approving does not send a referral. You send it from your hospital system, with the approved summary attached.
summary.approveDialogBody: It goes with the referral when you send it from your hospital system.
summary.rejectHelp: Your reason is kept with the draft and helps the team improve what AI writes.
summary.rejectedToast: Draft rejected. Your reason is kept with it.
summary.approvedNext: Send the referral from your hospital system, with this summary attached.
summary.rejectedNext: Write the summary yourself in your hospital system and attach it to the referral.

noDraft.notAvailable: No AI draft: drafting is not available yet.
noDraft.conflict: No AI draft: AI drafting is switched off, or this case already has an approved summary.
noDraft.unavailable: No AI draft: the AI service did not produce a draft it could check.
noDraft.error: No AI draft: the service is off or did not answer.

summary.noDraftBody: CareLoop cannot take a summary you write yourself yet. Write it in your hospital system and attach it to the referral. Every other step still works.

decisionFailed.forbidden: Only a clinician can approve or reject this summary.

decisionFailed.notAvailable: Saving a decision is not available yet.
decisionFailed.notFound: This draft no longer exists. Draft the summary again.
decisionFailed.invalid: The decision could not be saved. Check the text and try again.
decisionFailed.error: Your decision could not be saved. Try again.
